paragraph.text: Start by clearing old leaves from borders and checking stakes and ties. Sow tomatoes and peppers indoors on a sunny windowsill, keeping the compost moist but not wet. Prune late flowering shrubs before new growth appears, and divide large clumps of perennials to create new plants for free. Lawns benefit from a light rake to remove moss, followed by feed once the soil warms up. Watch out for slugs on young shoots after rain, and protect early blossom from frost with a sheet of fleece on cold nights. Start by clearing old leaves
